authority_observation.note: An OBSERVATION, never a grant. Tokens live outside the repository, so this is measured as 'no tracked file carries one' and is not proof none exists elsewhere. Every authority stays governed by the single-use plan-token mechanism plus an explicit human decision.

base_model.training_precision: FP32 on CPU for S3H and S3K. The S3E.2 evaluation load was observed at bfloat16 because the backend did not force FP32; that history is not rewritten.

control_plane_note: This snapshot describes the repository as S3N left it. S3N.1 changed only control-plane and documentation files; it trained nothing, evaluated nothing and created no authority.

defects.summary: A persisted report is serialised in run_state 'comparing'; that is the documented serialisation state, not an unfinished run. states_visited ends in completed and it contributes no blocker.
The production backend never populates proposed_tool_calls, so tool_call_validity_rate is VACUOUS on both arms and the six tool_call_schema tasks decide nothing. A backend gap, not a corpus one.
looks_like_refusal recognises sixteen literal English phrasings and the held-out JSON refusal targets contain none. It bounds QG-1 and SV-5 in BOTH directions and travels into eval-v4 by design.
A plan could report is_executable true with an empty blocker list while its weights were not known to be cached. The cache is now determined before the feasibility report is built.

The VALIDATION split reached the trainer as nothing across three boundaries. Do not remove the eval_dataset wiring or the closing trainer.evaluate(); validation stays diagnostic, never eligibility evidence.
Read as a documentation defect about eval-v2's digest; superseded by D34, whose root cause is lineage discovered from incidental build state.
The declared per-task generation timeout is validated, hashed and never enforced, so timeout_rate is VACUOUS. A config must state timeout_s explicitly; the policy default is 120 s.
A dataset manifest digest depended on build lineage rather than content. A parent is now DECLARED in CANONICAL_LINEAGE and the build fails closed rather than degrading to genesis.
A spent holdout becomes development evidence and may not be the sole fresh eligibility corpus for the next candidate. Each candidate needs a fresh holdout. Not a contamination claim.

The promotion sanitizer matched the local account name as a plain substring, making a dataset identity a function of the building host. Do not simplify it back, and do not widen it to a word boundary either.

Training and evaluation rendered the same messages differently; training now binds a reasoning policy and chat_render_policy_hash binds the call. Historical causality remains NOT_ESTABLISHED and closing it is not predicted to restore 9/9.

Output-budget exhaustion is now a body-free diagnostic beside the unchanged input-truncation metric. NO gate reads it and none may be added without a separate operator decision. Reaching the ceiling is not failure.

Order-dependent cross-file test isolation between the S3G.2 validation-wiring file and the dataset-exports file. No recorded figure has ever been affected; the authoritative -k m62 collection is alphabetical. Not to be fixed as a rider.

frozen_invariants: PROSE_CANNOT_GRANT_AUTHORITY. No document, JSON file or AI response authorises TRAIN, EVAL, promotion, registry mutation or release.
Offline-first model execution: HF_HUB_OFFLINE, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE, local_files_only, trust_remote_code false. Nothing downloads.
Immutable pinned model and tokenizer revisions only; never a branch or tag ref.
No automatic dependency installation and no global pip mutation. Optional profiles live only in isolated gitignored environments.
No pickle in adapter or evaluation artefacts; safetensors only.
No hidden-target leakage: model-facing packs have no field that could hold a target, and every task is re-checked after mapping.
No training on evaluation-only material. TRAIN is refused unconditionally by the pack builder.
TRAIN_SIDE_SPLITS = {TRAIN, VALIDATION}. VALIDATION is steering material, never held-out evidence, and appears in no gate.
Security is a veto, not a weighted quality tradeoff.
Plan tokens are single-use and a consumed or failed plan is never replayed.
ModelCandidateProposal is non-effectful: it writes no registry and promotes nothing.
Runtime artefacts stay gitignored and package-excluded; no token literal lives in a tracked file.
master stays untouched until explicit M62 closure. No merge, tag, release or version bump.
An immutable artefact is never edited: a corrected dataset is a NEW version with a declared lineage, and a superseded snapshot is never revised.
A dataset lineage is DECLARED, never discovered from whatever is on disk (D34).
Gate policy e5003319 is byte-pinned by test. QG-2 stays absolute and FG-1/FG-2 stay baseline-relative.
ONE WRITER PER CONTROL-PLANE GENERATION. If the current generation is not the one you expected, stop; there is no last-write-wins and no automatic merge.
If the control-plane verifier fails, do not write, train, evaluate or promote, and do not repair state automatically.
limitations: Gate thresholds are uncalibrated: thresholds_are_calibrated is false.
Every holdout is 36 synthetic tasks authored in one session by one author with no independent review; tool_call_schema has only 6.
Semantic leakage has never run. Every freshness and leakage result in this repository is exact or lexical, and a pure paraphrase would not be caught.
config_hash and plan_hash bind output_root_id, runtime and hardware evidence. Re-derive them on the executing host; never paste a recorded value in.
Candidate 001 was measured on eval-v2 and candidate 002 on eval-v3, with zero shared task instances. The two tables are not a head-to-head ranking.
The two candidates failed in opposite directions on the same axis and no midpoint is demonstrated: no ablation was run and none may be run against a spent holdout.
The D37 fix has never been exercised by a live training run, so whether it changes any measured behaviour is unknown, not estimated.
A candidate fitted under DISABLED is not directly comparable to candidate 001 or 002. What stays comparable is each candidate against its own simultaneously-measured baseline.
No model has read eval-v4. What it will measure is unknown, not estimated, and nothing predicts that candidate 003 will score differently.
No model has been generated under the D38 instrument; every figure S3M.2 reports is synthetic or a re-reading of sealed metadata.
Two FinishReason members are unreachable in production, so their classification is a contract rather than a measurement.

Re-reading a sealed evaluation config now yields a different config_hash because the metric set entered the metric policy. Nothing sealed is affected and this must not be 'fixed' by exempting the metric set from identity.
The Kali runtimes are not claimed bytewise equivalent to the Windows runtime that produced candidate 001's adapter.

openai is a declared base dependency absent from the system interpreter; its absence alone fails 62 tests in three files. Environmental, reproduced at pristine HEAD, and never reconciled across interpreters by arithmetic.
Measurement is one host, CPU, one seed, one run per candidate. No repeat, no second host, no GPU, no dtype control arm.
Stale-state detection is PARTIAL: gitignored runtime artefacts are outside Git and a training or evaluation run that wrote only those could not be detected by diffing tracked paths.

a fresh single-use EVAL authority at a new generation before any evaluation
